about: Papadmalji Agro Foods, based in Bikaner, Rajasthan, manufactures handmade, machine-made, rice (khichiya) and vrat-special papads and moongodi, plus white-label handmade papads and trading of cereal pellets. It sells under brands Zhakaas, Vishal, Rozana, Diamond and Papadmalji through 76 distributors, 30 wholesalers, modern trade, quick commerce and a merchant exporter. It runs two manufacturing units in Bikaner, has 118 employees and sold in 21 states and 3 UTs as of March 2026.

objects.purpose: Capex for new manufacturing facility at Bachhasar, Bikaner (building, plant and machinery, 250 kW rooftop solar)
Repayment or prepayment of bank borrowings

promoters.background: Jai Agarwal founded the business in 2012 as a proprietorship (Vishal Namkeen Bhandar) and has over a decade of papad industry experience. Prem Lata Agarwal is Whole-time Director. No promoter shares are pledged. India Customer Insight Fund (AIF) has been an investor since 2018 and is the selling shareholder.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 45.94% of FY26 revenue (69.25% in FY25, 69.65% in FY24); top 1 customer 9.08%, top 5 30.85%. Top 10 suppliers were 61.02% of purchases. Rajasthan is about 50% of revenue.

litigation_note: Only outstanding matter is income tax proceedings against the company of Rs 276.84 lakh (about Rs 2.77 crore), also shown as contingent liability. No criminal, regulatory or civil cases against the company, promoters or directors.
strengths: Wide distribution network: 76 distributors, 30 wholesalers, about 8,700 retail outlets, plus modern trade, quick commerce and a merchant exporter.
Diversified papad range (handmade, machine-made, rice, vrat, moongodi) under five brands, with Zhakaas, Vishal and Rozana as the key ones.
Profitability improved: EBITDA margin rose from 12.58% in FY24 to 25.16% in FY26 and PAT margin from 8.02% to 15.54%.
High return ratios: ROCE 46.47% and ROE 38.51% in FY26.
Debt to equity fell from 1.66 in FY24 to 0.62 in FY26 and net worth grew to Rs 16.14 crore.
Modern trade share of revenue grew from 26% in FY24 to 41% in FY26, reducing reliance on general trade.
Handmade papad model supports home-based women workers (Bataras and Bataris) and keeps a traditional, scalable supply base.
Two FSSAI-licensed units; one also ISO 22000:2018 certified, with a new automated unit planned.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers made up 45.94% of FY26 revenue (69.25% in FY25 and 69.65% in FY24); loss of a major customer or white-label client could hurt sales.

risks.title: Short-term debt repayable on demand
risks.detail: Short-term borrowings were Rs 9.03 crore at March 2026 and about Rs 10.74 crore at August 2026, repayable on demand and including a director loan; this creates liquidity risk.

risks.title: Volatile operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 2.75 crore in FY24 and only Rs 0.56 crore in FY26 against PAT of Rs 5.21 crore, due to receivables and inventory build-up.

risks.title: Capex orders not yet placed
risks.detail: Rs 7.90 crore of IPO money for the new Bachhasar unit is not yet ordered or spent; delays or cost overruns could affect the plan. The land is leased from the promoter.

risks.title: Supplier concentration and input costs
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers were 61.02% of FY26 purchases with no long-term contracts; pulses, oils and flours are bought at market prices.

risks.title: Brand dependence
risks.detail: Zhakaas, Vishal and Rozana account for about 88% of FY26 revenue; several trademarks are pending registration and some are opposed by third parties.

risks.title: Related-party dealings and rented premises
risks.detail: Promoters supply loans, rent and services, and manufacturing units and the new site are leased from the promoter. Related-party items include rent and remuneration paid to promoters.

risks.title: Regulatory filing lapses and tax dispute
risks.detail: Numerous delayed ROC filings (some delayed over 100 days) were noted, and income tax proceedings of Rs 2.77 crore are outstanding.

notes: Standalone restated financials (INR lakh converted to crore), FY24-FY26. Price band, offer amounts, P/E and GCP amount are blank in the RHP, so null. Issue size is 28,03,200 shares including 1,44,000 market maker portion; reservation percentages are for the net offer (QIB up to 50%, NII at least 15%, retail at least 35%). EBITDA is operating EBITDA excluding other income. FY26 other income was Rs 0.04 lakh, shown as 0.00. Founded year is incorporation (2017); business began in 2012 as a proprietorship. Balance sheet table was garbled; values reconciled with net worth, debt/equity KPIs and cash flow.
